nodes.title: PROMPT + REFERENCES (Ref2VA)
widgets_values:
subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the adult woman whose appearance comes from <Picture 1>. Preserve her face, clown makeup with blue teardrop marks, round pink-red clown nose, long wavy pink twin-tail hair with white fluffy cat-ear clips and colorful bead ties, rainbow choker, white blouse with a pink scalloped collar, pink suspender skirt with red and blue round buttons, white feathered wings with pink and blue markings, long pink gloves with rainbow cuffs and frilled rainbow wrist ruffles, and rainbow-striped thigh-high stockings.
<Picture 2> is the background only. It contains no subject. It supplies the room: a wall of tall vertical color bands (red, orange, yellow, green, blue, purple) and a dark glossy tiled floor that reflects the colors. Reproduce it as shown, with no added people or objects.

summary:
[reference generation] <Subject 1> stands shyly in front of the rainbow wall from <Picture 2>, then looks up, smiles, waves at the camera and ends standing relaxed with her arms at her sides, over an 8-second clip. The camera is stationary.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (throughout [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - retain her face, makeup, clown nose, hair, wings, costume, gloves and stockings from <Picture 1> while she moves.
<Picture 2> (background throughout [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - follow <Picture 2> exactly for the rainbow wall, the tiled floor and their lighting.

detailed_description:
Photorealistic live-action rendering with the same character appearance as the references, placed in the room from <Picture 2>. Soft, even light with colored reflections from the rainbow wall on the glossy floor. The camera is stationary for the entire clip: a locked-off, fixed medium-wide vertical frame, full body visible from head to knees, with no pan, tilt, zoom, or movement.

[Shot 1] <Subject 1> stands in the center of the frame in front of the rainbow wall, facing the camera, her gloved hands clasped low in front of her skirt and her head slightly lowered, looking shy. She lifts her head, meets the camera with her eyes and breaks into a bright smile. She unclasps her hands, raises her right gloved hand to shoulder height and waves at the camera twice, the rainbow ruffle at her wrist bouncing with each wave. She lowers her hand slowly and lets both arms rest relaxed at her sides. She ends standing still and centered, feet together, arms at her sides, smiling at the camera, until the end of the shot.

overall_soundscape:
Quiet indoor room tone, the soft rustle of her skirt and feathers, and light taps of her shoes on the tiled floor.

non_diegetic_music:
N/A

nodes.title: READ ME
widgets_values:
3-CLIP TEST (clown + rainbow wall)

1. Press Reset on CLOWN CHAIN, then Run / Re-roll -> clip 1 (prompt already loaded).
2. Happy with clip 1? Paste the CLIP 2 prompt into H3 Prompt IDE, then press Approve -> clip 2 (Prophecy runs here, ending = manual text already filled in).
3. Happy with clip 2? Paste the CLIP 3 prompt, then press Approve -> clip 3.
4. SMOOTH JOIN (right of SAVE THIS CLIP) rebuilds output/h3_ref2va/<clip 1> (ghép mượt).mp4 after every shot: repeated frames dropped, seams crossfaded. A re-rolled shot replaces its old take.

Not happy with a clip? Change the seed and press Run / Re-roll (not Approve).

HOW TO USE (H3 Motion Context 0.6.2)

Use the buttons on the CLOWN CHAIN node, not ComfyUI's Run:
• Run / Re-roll: make the current clip again (change the seed for a new take)
• Approve: keep this clip and make the next one
• Chain: keep approving automatically (segments = how many clips, 0 = until Stop)
• Reset: back to the start (Load 0 / Save 1)
• Clear latents: delete the saved clips in the folder

First clip: Load 0 / Save 1 (nothing is loaded, it starts fresh).
Then Load 1 / Save 2, and so on. The buttons step these for you.

Load, Save and Clown Chain must stay inside the "Context + Load/Save + Chain" group or the buttons do nothing.

Each clip is saved to output/h3_ref2va/ already trimmed, so you can drop them on a timeline back to back.

Length must be 17k+5 frames (192 = 8 s, 243 = 10 s, 362 = 15 s).
Set resolution and length on the PROMPT node (480x864 = 9:16 at 0.5 MP).

Refer to pictures in the prompt as <Picture 1>, <Picture 2>... in the order they plug into ref_image_0, ref_image_1...

nodes.title: SAVE this clip (for the next one)
H3 Prompt IDE - write the prompt here
widgets_values:
subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the rider, seen only in first-person view, whose look comes from <Picture 1>: an adult's left hand and forearm with lightly tanned matte skin, visible knuckles and fine arm hair, a black wristwatch on a dark strap, holding a padded black grab bar printed with yellow letters "MI5".
<Subject 2> is the alpine coaster environment in <Picture 1>: a single-seat sled with a curved brushed-steel frame and yellow plastic side pods on twin steel rails on a dark metal frame, a wet green meadow and steep slopes of spruce and pine forest.
<Subject 3> is the rainbow valley in <Picture 2>: two parallel, vivid double rainbow arcs glowing through humid mist over a dark forest-covered mountain, wet green treetops, and a small house with a red roof among the trees at the foot of the slope, soft diffused light.

summary:
[reference generation] The first-person coaster ride ends: the sled leaves the spiral, races down a forest corridor and out onto the meadow, brakes and rolls to a stop at the small red-roofed house from <Picture 2>, where the rider gives a thumbs up toward the double rainbow, over an 8-second clip.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - the hand, the wristwatch and the "MI5" grab bar are retained.
<Subject 2> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - the sled, rails, meadow and forest keep the look of <Picture 1>.
<Subject 3> (appears in [Shot 1]): partially_preserved - the red-roofed house, the misty mountain and the double rainbow follow <Picture 2>.

detailed_description:
The target video is in a photorealistic style with natural lighting and realistic textures: soft humid light, drifting mist, wet green meadow.
[Shot 1] First-person POV at eye height, the grab bar across the lower third of the frame, <Subject 1>'s hand gripping hard on its left half, the sled banking through the last turn of a tight spiral with the horizon tilted. The rails straighten and the horizon levels; the camera tracks forward at fast speed down a narrow corridor between tall spruce trunks, soft beams of light slanting through the mist. The forest opens and the sled shoots out onto the wet meadow, the small red-roofed house ahead with both rainbow arcs glowing over the misty mountain behind it. Brake fins catch under the sled; it slows smoothly, the grass sharpening from a blur into wet blades, and <Subject 1>'s grip loosens. The sled rolls under the shingled roof and stops with a gentle bump. The hand lifts off the bar, curls into a fist and raises a thumb up toward the rainbows, holding it there. The shot ends with the sled standing still at the station, the thumb raised in the lower left of the frame, the double rainbow glowing above the mountain.

overall_soundscape:
Wind roar and the whine of wheels on the spiral fading into a fast rumble through the forest, a long hiss of brake fins on the meadow, the wheels clicking slower and slower, a soft bump as the sled stops, water dripping from the eaves, birdsong, and the rider's breathless happy laugh.

non_diegetic_music:
N/A

WHERE TO GET THE NODES IN THIS WORKFLOW

Clown nodes + Clown Chain (Clown Context Suite):
https://github.com/roycho87/clown_context_suite

Load / Save Latent - install ONE of these, not both (they use the same node names):
  H3 Motion Context: https://github.com/NikoDemon80/ComfyUI-H3-Motion-Context
  H3 Motion Context MultiRef: https://github.com/seitanism/ComfyUI-H3-Motion-Context-MultiRef

H3 Prompt IDE:
https://github.com/ethanfel/ComfyUI-H3-Prompt-IDE

KJNodes (MiniMax low-VRAM / Sage attention nodes):
https://github.com/kijai/ComfyUI-KJNodes

ControlNet Auxiliary Preprocessors (only for Clown Carryover's depth / pose options; canny works without it):
https://github.com/Fannovel16/comfyui_controlnet_aux

VideoHelperSuite (Video Combine):
https://github.com/Kosinkadink/ComfyUI-VideoHelperSuite

ComfyUI-Custom-Scripts (Show Text):
https://github.com/pythongosssss/ComfyUI-Custom-Scripts

Everything else is built into ComfyUI. Update ComfyUI if the MiniMax H3 nodes are missing.
